reviews.title: App stole earned points. Support is a rude and unhelpful.
reviews.text:
Paid for the year. I spent months doing and hosting challenges to earn a high value gift card. The app crashed mid transaction, took the points, and has “pending” for two weeks after waiting a mandatory 30 days. Support has ghosted with assistance, calls me “eager,” and engineering can’t provide a resolution timeline. 

This app is refusing to pay a high tier gift card when their own back end system failure occurred. 

High risk high reward. Gift cards don’t process in WiFi and system will crash if reception wavers. 

For low risk high reward just invest in a high value gift card and use it as encouragement.

reviews.title: Almost
reviews.text:
I love so much about this app/service, but they’ve got to put more time into it. At this very moment I’ve gone to ChatGPT to ask it what constitutes a meal rated at 65%+. I’m not finding that. I have asked the community questions like this before but there’s not a section designated to hold MY stuff. So I can’t see replies to my questions. I can’t see which post has garnered a like or comment. (That’s important because I get points for those and I’d like to engage with that better.) If it worked FOR ME I would say it’s worth the cost. But at this moment I’m not finding it worth the cost. I hope they keep investing in this app though, because it’s a great concept! 
PS: I looked through the app for a “contact us” before I wrote this review and I haven’t been able to find it.

reviews.title: Won’t give me my rewards
reviews.text:
I paid for three months of this app and probably won’t renew. At first it was very suspect, but about two weeks into my subscription a major update happened that made the app much better. However, it has a big problem with locking up during the mini challenges and so I only get credit for doing one maybe two per day rather than all of them. It’s like the app doesn’t want me to earn enough points to get reward.
But I managed to cobble together my 2588 points to get a $25 gift card but the app won’t let me get it. It keeps saying that it is unable to process my request. It doesn’t matter what gift card I choose. At first, I was trying to get a Starbucks gift card then the Starbucks gift card option completely went away. So then I tried for PayPal for the last three days and it just says it’s unable to process my request. So I tried for a Sonic card with the same result. It is unable to complete my request. It says to ask for help through Settings, but when you go to settings, there’s nowhere to ask for help when you do find the help and support tab and you send them a message nobody EVER answers. I had kind of already decided to not renew my subscription, even though I was kind of enjoying doing the challenges and trying to meet the goals. But if you can’t get any rewards, then it’s not worth the money.
